name: CopySmith
summary: The old Copysmith copywriter is no longer sold under that name.
description: Copysmith’s site now describes the company as the parent of Frase, Describely, and Rytr. The previous card treated Copysmith as a free marketing writer. That product is not what the homepage sells.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: Not free. No current price for the discontinued copywriter was published on the homepage.

features: Bulk Content Generation: Produces product descriptions and other content at scale.
Centralized Content Management: Manages product content from a single platform.
Collaborative Editing: Enables real-time team collaboration on content.
SEO Optimization: Ensures content is optimized for search engines.
